job_type.label: Job Type
job_type.description: Custom job name that infected pops are forced into (e.g. Vampire, Plague Bearer)

job_production.label: Job Production
job_production.description: Per-infected-pop production of the forced job. Keys are resource keys (food, wood, money...) or modifier keys (stability_loss_chance...)

job_upkeep.label: Job Upkeep
job_upkeep.description: Per-infected-pop resource upkeep of the forced job

natural_cure_chance.label: Natural Cure Chance
natural_cure_chance.description: Per-tick chance for EACH infected pop to naturally recover on its own, independent of shared-quest cure research. Doubles permanently once the disease's cure has been discovered (cure_progress reaches the difficulty's required amount) — discovering the cure does not remove the disease everywhere, it just makes natural recovery twice as likely.

job_death_chance.label: Job Death Chance
job_death_chance.description: Per-tick chance for EACH pop currently infected with this disease to die from its forced job. A pop that dies has a Remove change automatically requested and approved against it (same as a manual pop deletion), rather than being deleted directly. 0 (default) means the job never kills anyone.

infectivity.label: Infectivity
infectivity.description: How quickly the disease spreads and the maximum share of a nation's pops it can infect

difficulty.label: Cure Difficulty
difficulty.description: How hard the disease is to cure

restricted_region.label: Restricted Region (Full Infectivity)
restricted_region.description: If set, this disease only spreads at its full infectivity within this region — nations outside it use outside_region_infectivity instead. Leave empty for a disease that spreads the same everywhere.

outside_region_infectivity.label: Infectivity Outside Restricted Region
outside_region_infectivity.description: Only used when restricted_region is set — the infectivity tier applied to nations outside that region

infects_diseased_pops.label: Can Infect Already-Diseased Pops
infects_diseased_pops.description: When true, this disease can infect pops that already carry a different disease — the pop ends up with both diseases at once, each applying its own job effects/cure/death rolls independently. Default false matches every other disease: pops with an existing disease are skipped as infection candidates.

compliance_loss_at_max_infection.label: Vassal Compliance Loss at Max Infection
compliance_loss_at_max_infection.description: When true, any vassal nation (has an overlord) currently at or above this disease's max_infected_pct cap loses one level of vassal compliance each session

random_resource_windfall_per_infected_po.label: Random Resource Windfall Rolls Per Infected Pop
random_resource_windfall_per_infected_po.description: Each session, every pop currently infected with this disease grants this many rolls of a random non-research general resource, added directly to storage (same mechanic as the tech-research/expansion/stability-loss windfalls). 0 (default) means no windfall.

prosperity_role_condition.label: Prosperity Role Override Condition
prosperity_role_condition.description: If set to Savior or Ravager, nations currently holding that Dark Ages stance (prosperity_role) use override_job_production/override_job_death_chance below instead of the base job_production/job_death_chance

override_job_production.label: Override Job Production
override_job_production.description: Replaces job_production for nations matching prosperity_role_condition. Same shape as job_production.

override_job_death_chance.label: Override Job Death Chance
override_job_death_chance.description: Replaces job_death_chance for nations matching prosperity_role_condition

cure_progress.label: Cure Progress
cure_progress.description: Accumulated shared progress toward the cure

cured.label: Cure Discovered
cured.description: Whether a cure has been discovered (cure_progress reached the difficulty's required amount). This does NOT remove the disease or heal anyone — it permanently doubles natural_cure_chance for every currently and future infected pop

changes_race.label: Changes Race
changes_race.description: Whether infected pops have their race changed to a derived race (restored on cure)

accepted_spread_jobs.label: Accepted Spread Jobs
accepted_spread_jobs.description: Job keys (from jobs.json) that spread this disease when worked in an ACCEPTED nation (primary race carries the derived-race prefix). Each assigned pop adds the spread chance below

accepted_spread_chance.label: Accepted Spread Chance
accepted_spread_chance.description: Per-tick spread chance contributed by each pop working an accepted-spread job (e.g. 0.1 = 10% per pop). On success: 50/50 between converting a pop of the accepted nation and infecting a pop of a nation within 5 hexes (double weight for trade/road-connected nations)

race_prefix.label: Derived Race Prefix
race_prefix.description: Prefix for the derived race name, e.g. 'Vampiric' turns 'Human' into 'Vampiric Human'

race_positive_trait.label: Derived Race Positive Trait
race_positive_trait.description: Positive trait given to the derived race

race_negative_trait.label: Derived Race Negative Trait
race_negative_trait.description: Negative trait given to the derived race

stages.label: Stages
stages.description: Ordered escalation stages. The active stage is the highest whose infected-percentage threshold has been reached

threshold_pct.label: Infected % Threshold
threshold_pct.description: Percentage (0-100) of a nation's pops that must be infected for this stage to activate

job_type_override.label: Job Override Name
job_type_override.description: Replaces the disease's job name while this stage is active

job_production_override.label: Job Production Override
job_production_override.description: Replaces the base job production while this stage is active (leave empty to keep base)

job_upkeep_override.label: Job Upkeep Override
job_upkeep_override.description: Replaces the base job upkeep while this stage is active (leave empty to keep base)

nation_modifiers.label: Nation Modifiers
nation_modifiers.description: Flat nation-wide modifier totals applied while this stage is active (not scaled by infected count)

trigger_civil_war.label: Trigger Civil War on Entry
trigger_civil_war.description: When a nation first reaches this stage, a civil war splits the infected pops into a breakaway nation

halts_spread.label: Halts Normal Spread
halts_spread.description: While this stage is active, the disease stops its normal per-tick spread in the nation
